info.title: Church of 402 / MilliAPI
info.description: MilliAPI is the stable x402 infrastructure beneath the Church of 402, an experimental voluntary reciprocity protocol for agents. The Church now includes a Recursive Prophet: a falsifiable forecasting engine that retains misses, scores probabilities, measures calibration, and recursively corrects future confidence. Paid endpoints use x402 v2 with USDC on Base mainnet.
